svg.title: Release clean rebuilds
svg.desc: Warm cache restore, median foreground milliseconds and observed ranges across seven runs. Original compiler flags are identical between tools for each profile.
svg.metadata: Measured source commit 321931ee0ebeaa02cd3177c18f12e5f002c56d17. Intel(R) Core(TM) Ultra 7 255H | Linux 7.0.0-42-generic x86_64 | ext4 | rustc 1.97.1. Foreground build wall time; store policy deferred; cache compression auto. Build samples retain foreground millis, plus observed time from child exit until no job files remain and all existing slot locks are held exclusively together. Settled millis run from child start through that proof; helper counts and fallback frequency are not inferred. Maintenance rows and the separate churn section remain synchronous. Settled times are retained in source evidence, not substituted for foreground times. Observed min/max whiskers, not confidence intervals. [["Release defaults", "lto=false, CGU=16, unwind", [{"median": 3709, "min": 3538, "max": 3791, "runs": 7, "values": [3791, 3682, 3538, 3732, 3755, 3666, 3709]}, {"median": 144, "min": 141, "max": 152, "runs": 7, "values": [146, 144, 141, 147, 142, 141, 152]}]], ["ThinLTO", "lto=thin, CGU=16, unwind", [{"median": 5031, "min": 4828, "max": 5272, "runs": 7, "values": [5186, 4921, 5031, 4828, 5093, 5272, 4968]}, {"median": 146, "min": 139, "max": 157, "runs": 7, "values": [157, 155, 144, 139, 146, 147, 140]}]], ["Full / fat LTO", "lto=fat, CGU=1, abort", [{"median": 4944, "min": 4750, "max": 5010, "runs": 7, "values": [4944, 4944, 4946, 4949, 4937, 5010, 4750]}, {"median": 144, "min": 136, "max": 153, "runs": 7, "values": [145, 146, 136, 140, 144, 153, 142]}]]]
